sn42.9:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena Nāḷandā tādavasāri ||
sn42.9:1.2: tatra sudam Bhagavā Nālandāyaṃ viharati Pāvarikambavane || || 2
sn42.9:2.1: Tena kho pana samayena Nālandā dubbhikkhā hoti dvīhitikā setaṭṭhikā salākāvuttā || || 3
sn42.9:2.2: Tena kho pana samayena Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto Nāḷandāyaṃ paṭivasati mahatiyā Nigaṇṭhaparisāya saddhiṃ || || 4
sn42.9:2.3: Atha kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi nigaṇṭhasāvako yena Nigaṇṭho Naṭaputto tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 5 Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Asibandhakaputtaṃ gāmaniṃ Nigaṇṭho Nāṭaputto etad avoca || ||
sn42.9:2.4: Ehi tvaṃ gāmani samaṇassa Gotamassa vādam āropehi
sn42.9:2.6: Asibandhakaputtena gāmaṇinā samaṇassa Gotamassa evam mahiddhikassa evam mahānubhāvassa vādo āropito ti || ||
sn42.9:3.1: Katham panāham bhante samaṇassa Gotamassa evam mahiddhikassa evam mahānubhāvassa vādam āropessāmī ti || || 6
sn42.9:3.2: Ehi tvaṃ gāmaṇi yena samano Gotamo tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā samaṇaṃ Gotamaṃ evaṃ vadehi ||
sn42.9:3.3: Nanu bhante Bhagavā anekapariyāyena kulānam anudayaṃ vaṇṇeti anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī ti || ||
sn42.9:3.4: Sace kho gāmaṇi samaṇo Gotamo evam puṭṭho evaṃ vyākaroti ||
sn42.9:3.5: Evam gāmaṇi tathāgato anekapariyāyena kulānam anudayaṃ vaṇṇeti anurukkhaṃ vaṇṇeti anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī ti || tam enaṃ vadeyyāsi || ||
sn42.9:3.6: Atha kiñcarahi bhante Bhagavā dubbhikkhe dvīhitike setaṭṭhike salākāvutte mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carati ||
sn42.9:3.7: ucchedāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno anayāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno upaghātāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno ti || ||
sn42.9:3.8: Imaṃ kho te gāmaṇi samaṇo Gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañham puṭṭho neva sakkhati uggilituṃ neva sakkhati ogilituṃ ti || || 7
sn42.9:3.9: Evam bhante ti kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Nigaṇṭhassa Nāṭaputtassa paṭisutvā uṭṭhāyasanā Nigaṇṭhaṃ Nātaputtam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 8 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.9:4.1: Nanu bhante Bhagavā anekapariyāyena kulānaṃ anudayam vaṇṇeti anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī ti || ||
sn42.9:4.2: Evaṃ gāmaṇi tathāgato anekapariyāyena kulānam anudayaṃ vaṇṇeti anurakkhaṃ vaṇṇeti anukampaṃ vaṇṇetī ti || ||
sn42.9:4.3: Atha kiñcarahi bhante Bhagavā dubbhikkhe dvīhitike setaṭṭhike salākāvutte mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ cārikaṃ carati ||
sn42.9:4.4: ucchedāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno anayāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno upaghātāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno ti || || 9
sn42.9:4.5: Ito so gāmaṇi ekanavutikappo yaṃ aham anussarāmi nābhijānāmi kiñci kulam pakkabhikkhānuppadānamattena upahatapubbaṃ ||
sn42.9:4.6: atha kho yāni tāni kulāni aḍḍhāni mahaddhanāni mahābhogāni pahūtajātarūparajatāni pahūtavittupakaraṇāni pahūtadhanadhaññāni || sabbāni tāni dānasambhūtāni ceva saccasambhūtāni ca saññamasambhūtāni ca || || 10
sn42.9:4.7: Aṭṭha kho gāmaṇi hetu aṭṭha paccayā kulānam upaghātāya ||
sn42.9:4.8: rājato vā kulāni upaghātam gacchanti || corato vā kulāni upaghātam gacchanti || aggito vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti || udakato vā kulāni upaghātaṃ gacchanti || nihitaṃ vā nādhigacchanti || duppayuttā vā kammantaṃ jahanti || kule va kulaṅgāroti uppajjati || yo te bhoge vikirati vidhamati viddhaṃseti aniccatā yeva aṭṭhamī ti || ||
sn42.9:4.9: Ime kho gāmaṇi aṭṭha hetu aṭṭha paccayā kulānam upaghātāya || || 11
sn42.9:4.10: Imesu kho gāmaṇi aṭṭhasu hetūsu aṭṭhasu paccayesu santesu saṃvijjamānesu yo mam evaṃ vadeyya
sn42.9:4.11: Ucchedāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno anayāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno upaghātāya Bhagavā kulānam paṭipanno ti ||
sn42.9:4.12: taṃ gāmaṇi vācam appahāya taṃ cittam appahāya taṃ diṭṭhiṃ apaṭinissajjitvā yathāhataṃ nikkhitto evam niraye ti || || 12
sn42.9:5.1: Evaṃ vutte Asibandhakaputto gāmaṇi Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn42.9:5.3: upāsakam mam Bhagavā dhāretu ajjatagge pānupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti || || 1
